name: API Layer
description: FastAPI factory in main.py, HTTP routes, and the MCP server that stream chat, sessions, uploads, retrieval, and GitHub.

name: Service Layer
description: Chat streaming, hybrid BM25 and FAISS retrieval, Groq and Gemini failover, document ingestion, GitHub context, and session orchestration.

name: Client Layer
description: Outbound adapters for LLM chat, embeddings, reranking, web search, and SSRF-guarded HTTP fetches.

name: Core Layer
description: Composition root, the sole environment reader, shared exceptions, and the SQLAlchemy engine and session factory.

name: Data Layer
description: Pydantic API schemas, SQLAlchemy tables for sessions, messages, documents, and GitHub, plus the on-disk data directory.

name: Utility Layer
description: Shared text, ranking, SSE, cache, rate-limit, time, and URL-safety helpers used across the backend.

name: Frontend
description: Vanilla JavaScript chat SPA: shell, workspace components, theme, and stylesheets mounted by the FastAPI app.

name: Test Layer
description: Pytest suite and headless browser harness that lock import boundaries, retrieval, providers, and the SPA.

name: Documentation
description: README, dependency lists, redesign specs, QA reports, and the vendored Lucide icon license.

name: Configuration
description: Environment sample, Pipenv manifest, pytest settings, the staged settings module, and the Procfile that starts uvicorn.
